Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with blocks. He had a big box of blocks that he liked to stack on top of each other. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy wanted to build a tower too, but Timmy didn't want to share. They began to argue and shout.

Timmy's mom heard the loud singing and came to see what was happening. She asked him to be patient and share his blocks with him. Timmy thought about it and decided to be patient and share his blocks with Billy. They both played with the blocks
